title: Hastings 1066: Three Kings Racing for One Crown in a Single Autumn
summary: Tells the race for the English throne after Edward the Confessor died without an heir in 1066, between Harold Godwinson, King Harald Hardrada of Norway and Duke William of Normandy. The episode covers the victory at Stamford Bridge and the hard march south that followed, the shield wall broken at Hastings on the fourteenth of October, Harold's death, and the end of Anglo-Saxon England.
